items.title: Inside Prometheus: Meta’s Journey to a Gigawatt-Scale Supercluster
items.summary: With the recent release of the Muse family of foundational models, we want to take you inside the infrastructure that has made it all possible. The first phase of Prometheus, our gigawatt-scale supercluster, is already complete and we’re working toward scaling it to comprise  ~1 million GPUs. Prometheus also features technologies like closed-loop liquid cooling [...]Read More...The post Inside Prometheus: Meta’s Journey to a Gigawatt-Scale Supercluster appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
